ideas.title: Minnesota Child Care Subsidies Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the HHS warning to Minnesota regarding potential repayment of millions for withholding child care program records. Look into potential mismanagement or fraud in Minnesota's child care subsidies program.
questions: What are the details of the HHS warning?
How much money is potentially at risk?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant mismanagement or fraud in Minnesota's child care subsidies program. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue and potential connections to other programs or entities.
